dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: Oh! I haven't seen you anywhere in Veluriyam Mirage before. Have you traveled here from afar?

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: Ah, I know! You're the one everyone is talking about, the great hero who fixed the Mirage for Miss Idyia!

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: Sorry, I should have introduced myself. My name is Mandora, a resident here, and... a former adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: I've been living here for quite some time. Ask me if you have any questions about the place.

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: Yes, I used to be an adventurer, but not now.

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: After stumbling into this Mirage during a desert adventure, I decided to make it my home, and live a peaceful and stable life!

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: Since then, I haven't left. No more adventures...

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: That's okay. Great heroes have to stay on the move... Or perhaps, it is only by staying on the move that one can gradually become a hero?

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: Oh, I misspoke earlier. I should have said, "I stopped adventuring in Mandora's stead."

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: She left me here, and returned to her world of thrilling travels and brilliant adventures. Tsk, she really is a clever girl! But you know, that's just typical of adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: Just like how anyone swearing "This is the last time, I promise!" always breaks their promises!

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: *sigh* Of course, after becoming "Mandora," I can understand how she felt... So it's not like I'll get riled up over it. It's just that...

dialogues.speaker: Mandora
dialogues.text: After she left the Mirage... does she ever still think of me? If the thought of me could strengthen her resolve and help her walk her chosen path, that would really be something, haha.
